posts.name: Craig
posts.cooked:
Hey, everyone!

 

First of all, hi! I haven't been here in a while. But you're going to be seeing me more. :-)

Secondly, I need people! Specifically, I need Citizens for conventions!

If you don't know what this means, it means that I'm looking for folks to help us out at our booth. That's probably running demos of various games, but it could mean other things. Who knows!

Right now, I'm looking for UK Games Expo. If you're interested in helping out and want a badge, send us an email to contact@greaterthangames.com!
